CheckOut.description:
Whether a completed scan passes a threshold and a minimum coverage, on the server
(MartianSecurity/martian-notes#400, #402). The gate policy file (#470) is read into these terms.
CheckOut.title: CheckOut

GateFinding.description: A finding at or above the threshold and what the gate made of it.
GateFinding.title: GateFinding

MatchCounts.description: How this scan's findings compare with the subject's earlier scans (MartianSecurity/martian-notes#403).
MatchCounts.title: MatchCounts

ReferenceOut.description:
One reference of a scan and what resolving it found (MartianSecurity/martian-notes#434), in the shape of
the scanner's contract (``#/$defs/reference``) plus the findings that cite it.
ReferenceOut.title: ReferenceOut

RefusalDetail.description:
Why a request was refused: a stable ``code``, a message, and the limit, window or field errors when
there are some.
RefusalDetail.title: RefusalDetail

RefusalOrInvalid.description: A 422: a refusal with its code, or a request FastAPI could not read (its list of errors).
RefusalOrInvalid.title: RefusalOrInvalid

ScanFindingOut.description: A finding with its receipts, as the scan record and the JSON export hold it.
ScanFindingOut.title: ScanFindingOut

TrackOut.description: One finding of a subject across its scans, as it stands now.
TrackOut.title: TrackOut

TriageOut.description: The answer to a triage action; its top-level fields are the audit log entry's details.
TriageOut.title: TriageOut

TriageState.description:
The triage behind a finding's status: an acceptance (with its reason, member and end) and the
waiver that holds, if any.
TriageState.title: TriageState

app__scanner_gate__GateOut.description: One evaluation of a scan against a gate policy file.
app__scanner_gate__GateOut.title: GateOut

info.description: The customer /v1/scanner routes of the hosted backend (not the worker's). Generated by scripts/scanner-scans-contract.py; do not edit by hand.
info.title: Martian Scanner scan API

parameters.description: A request id the client chose (a UUID). The same id with the same upload answers the scan it created (200) instead of starting another
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: A request id the client chose (a UUID). The same id with the same upload answers the scan it created (200) instead of starting another
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

archive.description: A ZIP file; the second part

manifest.description: JSON, at most 16 KiB; the first part

anyOf.description:
The commit an upload is of, as the client states it (MartianSecurity/martian-notes#472). The backend
records it and does not verify it.
anyOf.title: ScanGit

manifest.title: UploadManifest

200.description: The scan an earlier upload with the same Idempotency-Key and the same manifest and archive created

409.description: `request_id_reused`: the Idempotency-Key was used for another upload

413.description: A limit was passed; `detail.limit` names it

422.description: The manifest or the archive is refused

200.description: The scan as JSON or SARIF 2.1.0
